notes.title: Startup! Official Discord
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

If you’ve wishlisted Startup! (thank you!!), or you’re just curious about the wild ride from garage dev to indie legend — we’ve got a place just for you:

👉 [url=discord.gg/fKPF4zK7SM]Join the Startup! Discord here![/url]
Our Discord is where all the fun happens:

💬 Chat with other players (and me, the dev!)

🧠 Share feedback and ideas

🐞 Report bugs and weirdness

🎉 Get sneak peeks, dev updates, and cursed behind-the-scenes content

😂 Meme about how broken things are (on purpose, mostly)

Whether you’re here to follow the game’s journey, offer feedback, or just vibe with fellow chaos enjoyers — come hang out! We’re building something weird, and you’re invited.

All the best, 
Specs
Developer of Startup!
